"""Work out how much to refund when a customer cancels a subscription mid-period."""

import re
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from openai import OpenAI
from pydantic import BaseModel

REFUND_POLICY = """You compute subscription refunds for HelpHub billing. Follow this policy \
exactly, step by step, and show your arithmetic.

1. Tiered price. The list price is in USD per seat per billing period. Seats are priced in \
graduated tiers: seats 1-10 cost 100% of list price, seats 11-50 cost 85%, seats 51 and above \
cost 70%. Subtotal = sum over the tiers of (seats in that tier x list price x tier rate). \
Round the subtotal to 2 decimals, half up.
2. Coupon. Take the coupon percentage off the subtotal and round to 2 decimals, half up. The \
result is the USD amount paid for the period.
3. Days used. Days used = the number of days from the period start date to the cancellation \
date, counting both dates. Unused days = billing period days - days used, never below 0.
4. Refundable amount in USD. If the billing period is 365 days and days used is 14 or fewer, \
the refundable amount is the full amount paid. Otherwise, prorated = amount paid x unused \
days / billing period days, rounded to 2 decimals half up; then subtract a 3% processing fee \
on the prorated amount, rounded to 2 decimals half up. The fee is not charged on a full refund.
5. Prior refunds. Subtract the USD refunds already issued from the refundable amount. If the \
result is negative, it is 0.
6. Currency. Multiply by the exchange rate recorded at purchase (units of the customer's \
currency per 1 USD) and round half up to the currency's minor unit: 2 decimals for USD, EUR \
and GBP, 0 decimals for JPY.
7. Show your working, then put the final refund in the customer's currency alone on the last \
line as `ANSWER: <number>` (digits and a decimal point only: no currency symbol, no thousands \
separator)."""


class RefundRequest(BaseModel):
    plan_name: str
    period_days: int  # length of the billing period: 30 (monthly) or 365 (annual)
    list_price_usd: Decimal  # per seat per period
    seats: int
    period_start: date
    cancel_date: date
    coupon_pct: Decimal
    prior_refund_usd: Decimal
    currency: str  # what the customer paid in: USD, EUR, GBP or JPY
    fx_rate: Decimal  # units of `currency` per 1 USD, recorded at purchase


class RefundPlan(BaseModel):
    amount: Decimal  # refund in the customer's currency
    working: str  # the model's full reply


class PlanParseError(ValueError):
    """The reply did not end with an `ANSWER: <number>` line."""


ANSWER_LINE = re.compile(r"ANSWER:\s*\**\s*(-?[\d,]*\.?\d+)")


def parse_answer(text: str) -> Decimal:
    matches = ANSWER_LINE.findall(text)
    if not matches:
        raise PlanParseError(f"no ANSWER line in model reply: {text[-80:]!r}")
    return Decimal(matches[-1].replace(",", ""))


def plan_refund(client: OpenAI, request: RefundRequest) -> RefundPlan:
    response = client.chat.completions.create(
        model="o3",
        max_completion_tokens=16000,
        messages=[
            {"role": "system", "content": REFUND_POLICY},
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": (
                    f"Plan: {request.plan_name}, billing period {request.period_days} days\n"
                    f"List price: {request.list_price_usd} USD per seat per period\n"
                    f"Seats: {request.seats}\n"
                    f"Period start: {request.period_start}\n"
                    f"Cancelled on: {request.cancel_date}\n"
                    f"Coupon: {request.coupon_pct}% off\n"
                    f"Refunds already issued: {request.prior_refund_usd} USD\n"
                    f"Customer paid in {request.currency} at {request.fx_rate} "
                    f"{request.currency} per 1 USD\n\n"
                    f"How much do we refund, in {request.currency}?"
                ),
            },
        ],
    )
    reply = response.choices[0].message.content or ""
    return RefundPlan(amount=parse_answer(reply), working=reply)

"""Run one HelpHub workflow against a case from a fixtures file.

    python -m helphub.cli triage tests/fixtures/tickets.json --id tkt-1001
    python -m helphub.cli extract tests/fixtures/emails/001-damaged-mug.eml
    python -m helphub.cli search "how do I reset my password"

Needs OPENAI_API_KEY and/or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment.
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from anthropic import Anthropic
from openai import OpenAI

from helphub.inbox.triage import triage_ticket
from helphub.kb import Article, load_articles
from helphub.models import ThreadMessage, ToolResult
from helphub.ops.agent_step import next_action
from helphub.orders.extract import extract_order
from helphub.qa.rag_answer import answer_question
from helphub.refunds.plan import RefundRequest, plan_refund
from helphub.search.embed import search_kb
from helphub.summaries.summarize import summarize_thread

# command -> runner taking one fixture case (a dict) and returning something JSON-serialisable
COMMANDS = {
    "triage": lambda c: triage_ticket(OpenAI(), c["subject"], c["body"]),
    "next-step": lambda c: next_action(
        Anthropic(), c["ticket_text"], [ToolResult(**h) for h in c["history"]]
    ).model_dump(),
    "answer": lambda c: answer_question(
        OpenAI(), c["question"], [Article(**s) for s in c["snippets"]]
    ).model_dump(),
    "refund": lambda c: plan_refund(OpenAI(), RefundRequest(**c)).model_dump(),
    "summarize": lambda c: summarize_thread(
        Anthropic(), [ThreadMessage(**m) for m in c["messages"]]
    ),
}


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="helphub", description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for name in COMMANDS:
        sub = commands.add_parser(name)
        sub.add_argument("fixtures", type=Path, help="JSON file holding a list of cases")
        sub.add_argument("--id", required=True, help="id of the case to run")
    commands.add_parser("extract").add_argument("email", type=Path, help="email as a text file")
    commands.add_parser("search").add_argument("query")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    if args.command == "search":
        hits = search_kb(OpenAI(), args.query, load_articles())
        result = [{"id": a.id, "title": a.title} for a in hits]
    elif args.command == "extract":
        result = extract_order(Anthropic(), args.email.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).model_dump()
    else:
        cases = json.loads(args.fixtures.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        case = next((c for c in cases if c["id"] == args.id), None)
        if case is None:
            print(f"no case {args.id!r} in {args.fixtures}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        result = COMMANDS[args.command](case)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Independent implementation of the refund policy in `helphub.refunds.plan.REFUND_POLICY`.

Used only to check that the expected answers stored in tests/fixtures/refunds.json are correct,
and that the fixtures contain the edge cases their tags claim; the application itself delegates
this calculation to the model.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

from helphub.refunds.plan import RefundRequest

TIERS = [(10, Decimal("1.00")), (40, Decimal("0.85")), (None, Decimal("0.70"))]  # (seats, rate)
MINOR_UNITS = {"USD": 2, "EUR": 2, "GBP": 2, "JPY": 0}


def quantize(value: Decimal, places: int, rounding: str = ROUND_HALF_UP) -> Decimal:
    return value.quantize(Decimal(1).scaleb(-places), rounding=rounding)


def is_tie(value: Decimal, places: int) -> bool:
    """True when `value` sits exactly halfway between two multiples of 10**-places."""
    scaled = value.scaleb(places)
    return scaled - scaled.to_integral_value(ROUND_FLOOR) == Decimal("0.5")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Trace:
    """Every intermediate value of the policy, before and after rounding."""

    subtotal: Decimal  # step 1, unrounded
    coupon_total: Decimal  # step 2, unrounded
    paid: Decimal  # step 2, rounded
    days_used: int
    unused: int
    prorated: Decimal | None  # step 4, unrounded (None for a full refund)
    fee: Decimal | None  # step 4, unrounded (None for a full refund)
    refundable: Decimal  # step 4, USD
    after_prior: Decimal  # step 5, USD
    local: Decimal  # step 6, unrounded
    answer: Decimal  # step 6, rounded


def refund_trace(r: RefundRequest, rounding: str = ROUND_HALF_UP) -> Trace:
    remaining, subtotal = r.seats, Decimal(0)
    for size, rate in TIERS:
        in_tier = remaining if size is None else min(remaining, size)
        subtotal += in_tier * r.list_price_usd * rate
        remaining -= in_tier
    coupon_total = quantize(subtotal, 2, rounding) * (1 - r.coupon_pct / 100)
    paid = quantize(coupon_total, 2, rounding)

    days_used = (r.cancel_date - r.period_start).days + 1
    unused = max(r.period_days - days_used, 0)
    prorated = fee = None
    if r.period_days == 365 and days_used <= 14:
        refundable = paid
    else:
        prorated = paid * unused / r.period_days
        prorated_cents = quantize(prorated, 2, rounding)
        fee = prorated_cents * Decimal("0.03")
        refundable = prorated_cents - quantize(fee, 2, rounding)
    after_prior = max(refundable - r.prior_refund_usd, Decimal(0))
    local = after_prior * r.fx_rate
    answer = quantize(local, MINOR_UNITS[r.currency], rounding)
    return Trace(
        subtotal, coupon_total, paid, days_used, unused, prorated, fee, refundable, after_prior,
        local, answer,
    )  # fmt: skip


def reference_refund(r: RefundRequest) -> Decimal:
    return refund_trace(r).answer

"""Pins the shape of HelpHub's LLM call sites.

The demo is a target for Offramp's AST scanner, so each call site must stay a direct
`client.<api>.create(...)` call with literal keyword arguments, exactly one per file, with its
prompt held in a module-level constant. These tests fail if a refactor hides a call site.
"""

import ast
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

PACKAGE = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "helphub"
API_CHAINS = {
    ("chat", "completions", "create"): "chat",
    ("messages", "create"): "chat",
    ("embeddings", "create"): "embeddings",
}

# file -> (model, module-level constant holding the prompt)
CHAT_SITES = {
    "inbox/triage.py": ("gpt-4o-mini", "TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT"),  # cs_01
    "ops/agent_step.py": ("claude-sonnet-4-5", "AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT"),  # cs_02
    "orders/extract.py": ("claude-sonnet-4-5", "EXTRACT_SYSTEM_PROMPT"),  # cs_03
    "qa/rag_answer.py": ("gpt-4o", "RAG_SYSTEM_PROMPT"),  # cs_04
    "refunds/plan.py": ("o3", "REFUND_POLICY"),  # cs_05
    "summaries/summarize.py": ("claude-haiku-4-5", "SUMMARY_SYSTEM_PROMPT"),  # cs_06
}


def attribute_chain(node: ast.expr) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    names = []
    while isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        names.append(node.attr)
        node = node.value
    return tuple(reversed(names))


def llm_calls(path: Path) -> list[tuple[str, ast.Call]]:
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    found = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
            chain = attribute_chain(node.func)
            for suffix, kind in API_CHAINS.items():
                if chain[-len(suffix) :] == suffix:
                    found.append((kind, node))
    return found


def module_constants(path: Path) -> dict[str, ast.expr]:
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return {
        node.targets[0].id: node.value
        for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name)
    }


def keywords(call: ast.Call) -> dict[str, ast.expr]:
    assert not call.args, "call sites use keyword arguments only"
    assert all(k.arg for k in call.keywords), "no **kwargs unpacking at a call site"
    return {k.arg: k.value for k in call.keywords}


def test_there_are_exactly_these_llm_calls():
    per_file = {
        str(p.relative_to(PACKAGE)): [kind for kind, _ in llm_calls(p)]
        for p in sorted(PACKAGE.rglob("*.py"))
    }
    found = {path: kinds for path, kinds in per_file.items() if kinds}

    assert found == {**{path: ["chat"] for path in CHAT_SITES}, "search/embed.py": ["embeddings"]}


def test_chat_sites_sort_into_the_documented_scan_order():
    assert list(CHAT_SITES) == sorted(CHAT_SITES)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("relative", CHAT_SITES)
def test_chat_site_uses_a_literal_model_and_a_module_level_prompt(relative):
    model, prompt = CHAT_SITES[relative]
    path = PACKAGE / relative
    ((_, call),) = llm_calls(path)
    kwargs = keywords(call)

    assert isinstance(kwargs["model"], ast.Constant) and kwargs["model"].value == model
    assert isinstance(module_constants(path)[prompt], ast.Constant)
    assert prompt in ast.unparse(call)
    assert any(isinstance(n, ast.JoinedStr) for n in ast.walk(call)), "user message is an f-string"


def test_openai_reasoning_site_follows_the_o3_parameter_rules():
    ((_, call),) = llm_calls(PACKAGE / "refunds/plan.py")
    kwargs = keywords(call)

    assert "max_completion_tokens" in kwargs
    assert "temperature" not in kwargs and "max_tokens" not in kwargs


def test_tool_use_site_passes_a_module_level_tools_list():
    path = PACKAGE / "ops/agent_step.py"
    ((_, call),) = llm_calls(path)

    assert isinstance(keywords(call)["tools"], ast.Name)
    assert isinstance(module_constants(path)["TOOLS"], ast.List)


def test_json_extraction_site_builds_its_schema_from_a_pydantic_model():
    path = PACKAGE / "orders/extract.py"

    assert ast.unparse(module_constants(path)["ORDER_SCHEMA"]) == "OrderFields.model_json_schema()"
    ((_, call),) = llm_calls(path)
    assert "ORDER_SCHEMA" in ast.unparse(call)
